具有強烈的致幻效果，必須小心別靠它太近。
research.PORTALSCROLL.stage.1: Studying portals, I realised that space can be not only torn, but described. A scroll holds not the road itself, but its impression — the aura of a place, the breathing of nearby nodes, the echo of stone and light. A clean sheet, an essence crystal and a diamond, steeped in vis, become ink that remembers coordinates. An error in the writing leaves the seam open longer than it should, and Flux seeps out while foreign whispers find a way closer.
research.PORTALSCROLL.stage.2: I assembled the scroll on the arcane workbench: a diamond, a sheet of paper and an essence crystal, charged with two hundred units of vis. When the runes had dried, I touched the scroll to a stone — and it remembered the point. A second strike unfolded it before me: an even rift with the chosen place beyond, as though seen through a thickness of glass. The passage does not last and dislikes haste; the last traveller must step through before the scroll is rolled up.
research.PORTALSCROLL.title: Portal Scroll
research.POTIONSPRAYER.stage.1:
我進行了一些初步測試，利用源質來重現藥水的釀造系統。而我的成果有好有壞。
我應該致力於使它正常運作。
research.POTIONSPRAYER.stage.2:
經歷了一番挫折，我總算從失敗的瓶頸中獲得了些許成果。我確實可以混和藥水所包含的源質來重現其魔法藥效，然而成品卻非常不穩定。 沒有任何方法能將這些藥水倒入藥瓶——至少我試過的方法都行不通。
這些揮發性物質只要接觸到空氣就會立即消散，但藥水效果依然可以作用於附近物體，就像飛濺藥水。
我將製作出的東西稱為藥水噴霧器。你只需要給它一瓶做為樣本的藥水，並提供正確類型的源質，噴霧器就會製出該藥水並存放於其中。藥水能儲存8份。
當它收到紅石訊號時就會對其前方3*3*3的範圍噴灑一份藥水。
research.POTIONSPRAYER.title: 藥水噴霧器
research.PRIMALCRUSHER.stage.1:
The variable and malleable nature of Void Metal has openend up some interesting possibilities.
I believe it should be possible to create a tool with inherent morphic instability. In other words it will constantly fluctuate between various states so rapdily that it might not be visible to the naked eye.
research.PRIMALCRUSHER.stage.2:
Success! I have created a tool I am calling the Primal Crusher. It has the essential nature of both a pickaxe and a shovel. It does not look like either of those tools, but it defintely functions like them. Better in fact. It is also surprisingly effective against Taint.
It is slightly unpleasant to hold however - it seems to vibrate in one's hand and the feeling becomes quite uncomfortable after a while. A little discomfort will not stop me from using it however.
research.PRIMALCRUSHER.title: Primal Crusher
research.PRIMPEARL.stage.1:
我這輩子第一次遇到自認無法解開的謎團。
這個東西蘊含著純粹的原初要素，然而其特性卻與我所知的普通原初要素相異。 對此現象我持數種理論：
第一，這種「珠子」可能是現實世界創世初期的原初物質所殘留下——在它們融合成複合要素之前就已存在的原始魔法。
或者，這種原初物質的來源處的魔法規則可能與我所知相違。 我不確定何種解釋較令人擔憂。
無論如何，這顆珠子都是一個強大且蘊含著近乎無限魔力的至寶。
完整的寶珠極其罕見，通常都已衰退成團塊，甚至是微粒。然而即使是一點微粒也相當珍貴。
research.PRIMPEARL.title: 原初寶珠
research.Pech.stage.1:
這些詭異的亞人會出現在次元間隔較薄弱的區域。看起來似乎是受到這些地方豐沛的魔法能量所吸引。arcaneresearch:textures/research/research5.png:128:136:108:117:.75別被它們的矮小給蒙蔽，它們驚人的力量足以攜帶比自己體重高上數倍的物品。
地精通常不具攻擊性，但一旦被激怒就會成群合作擊倒攻擊它們的敵人。而一般情況下它們會儘量主動避開人們。
地精的貪婪可以說是惡名昭彰，即使較偏好珍貴的物件，依然會試圖奪走所有沒釘死的物品。坊間有此一說，若你有辦法滿足地精對財富的慾望，或許可以與它們友善往來。
若能與之結識它們可能會帶一些神奇的物件來與你分享。
然而必須注意的是這樣的「友誼」通常不會持續太久。
research.Pech.title: 地精
research.RECHARGEPEDESTAL.stage.1: 我預期我很快就會開始製造一些需要以魔素運作的道具，但這些道具無法輕易的自動從靈氣中汲取魔素。我需要一個充魔手段
research.RECHARGEPEDESTAL.stage.2: 這個特製的台座可以替有魔素容量的物品充魔。任何可以充魔的物品都能在這個台座中汲取靈氣中的魔素以補滿自身的容量。只需持欲充魔的物品點擊基座，再次點擊即可取下。
research.RECHARGEPEDESTAL.title: 充魔基座
research.REDSTONERELAY.stage.1: 我一直對魔法裝置與紅石訊號表面上的的負面反應很感興趣。我應該進一步研究這種現象並找出實際的用途。
research.REDSTONERELAY.stage.2:
雖然紅石訊號抑制魔法的效果眾所皆知，但經過研究後我發現在特定情況下卻有相反的效果。
其中一像實際應用為紅石繼能器。你可以將紅石訊號通過魔素結晶之類的魔法物質來任意增強或減弱紅石訊號。
繼能器擺放方式和紅石中繼器差不多，輸出端標有紅石火把。
不同於中繼器，繼能器有兩處可供調整——後方的旋鈕用來調整蓋過抑制效應並觸發繼能器所需要的最低紅石訊號強度。
前方的旋鈕（紅石火把旁）調整繼能器觸發後所送出的紅石訊號強度。
舉例來說，你可以讓繼能器在接收到強度2以上的紅石訊號時輸出強度7的訊號。
research.REDSTONERELAY.title: 紅石繼能器
research.RIFTCLOSER.stage.1: 我必須在這些裂痕成長、失控前找到方法關上它們。
research.RIFTCLOSER.stage.2:
我利用咒波裂痕對這種混沌能量進行研究，得到了一些有趣的發現：裂痕本身並不安定。理論上當它失去穩定時應該會自然閉合，但現實世界的法則不會讓這種情況發生——不穩定的能量會隨著小規模的爆發釋放出來。這或許算是一件好事——若是完全失衡的裂痕崩塌可能會產生災難性的能量爆發。
我覺得我已經找出能在裂痕完全失衡前觸發崩潰的方法——簡而言之，我要把它炸了。
然而，一般的爆炸是無效的——我需要的爆炸破壞力必須能穿透一般的三維空間。我為此設計了一種爆裂物，我將它稱為因果塌陷。這顆脈動的紅色球體必須盡可能地拋向裂痕。理論上它應該能破壞支撐裂痕的混沌能量。
但壞消息是根據我的計算，裂痕崩塌時將釋出一股強大、不穩定的原初能量——裂痕愈不穩定，釋出的能量就愈龐大。我必須在進行爆破前維持裂痕的穩定。
research.RIFTCLOSER.title: 關閉咒波裂痕
research.RUNICARMOR.stage.1:
Runic shielding need not be hammered into armor plate. A collection of charms, rings and similar protective baubles worn with everyday clothes can hold the same barrier.
These vessels create the same pool of hit points from which damage is subtracted first. I have sketched three basic vessels: a ring, an amulet and a girdle, each forged from a mundane bauble blank on the infusion altar.
research.RUNICARMOR.stage.2:
Infusion plans for the basic vessels are complete: the Ring of Runic Shielding, the Amulet of Runic Shielding and the Girdle of Runic Shielding.
Each vessel can later be refined into a specialized variant with its own trick.
research.RUNICARMOR.title: Runic Shielding Charms
research.RUNICCHARGED.stage.1: This specialized Ring of Shielding holds slightly less charge than the ring it is based on, but it quickens the shield's recharge. Wearing more than one effectively shortens the recharge cycle further.
research.RUNICCHARGED.stage.2: Infusion plan for the Charged Ring of Shielding: a shielding ring reforged with fire crystals and a potion of swiftness.
research.RUNICCHARGED.title: Charged Ring of Shielding
research.RUNICEMERGENCY.stage.1:
This specialized Amulet of Shielding holds slightly less charge than the amulet it is based on, but when the shielding is breached it instantly restores 8 points of shielding.
The effect cannot trigger more than once a minute.
research.RUNICEMERGENCY.stage.2: Infusion plan for the Amulet of Emergency Shielding: a shielding amulet reforged with earth crystals and a potion of strength.
research.RUNICEMERGENCY.title: Amulet of Emergency Shielding
research.RUNICHEALING.stage.1:
This specialized Ring of Shielding holds slightly less charge than the ring it is based on, but when the shielding is breached it releases a pulse of regenerative energy that lasts a few seconds.
The effect cannot trigger more than once every 20 seconds.
research.RUNICHEALING.stage.2: Infusion plan for the Revitalizing Ring of Shielding: a shielding ring reforged with water crystals and a potion of regeneration.
research.RUNICHEALING.title: Revitalizing Ring of Shielding
research.RUNICKINETIC.stage.1:
This specialized Girdle of Shielding holds slightly less charge than the girdle it is based on, but when the shielding is breached a detonation of kinetic energy is released, damaging and shoving back anything nearby.
The effect cannot trigger more than once every 20 seconds.
research.RUNICKINETIC.stage.2: Infusion plan for the Kinetic Girdle of Shielding: a shielding girdle reforged with air crystals and a splashed potion of harming.
research.RUNICKINETIC.title: Kinetic Girdle of Shielding
research.RUNICSHIELDING.stage.1: 事實證明附有魔法的道具用來攻擊或是達成各種功能都相當容易，但增強防禦能力也有其必要。應加以調查。
research.RUNICSHIELDING.stage.2:
針對防護魔法的研究使我發現了盧恩護盾。這並不是傳統意義上的盔甲，而是一種在大部分配件與盔甲上附魔，用來創造出魔法能量屏障來防禦大多數的傷害。護盾有自己的傷害槽容量，受傷害時會優先從中扣除，以保護穿戴者不受傷害。若傷害槽容量耗盡，穿戴者就會像平常一樣受傷。傷害槽會隨時間恢復，但需要從靈氣中汲取魔素來補充其容量。
同一個物件可以透過重複附魔來增加其保護力，然而每次附魔都會漸趨昂貴。
這個護甲對某些環境傷害並沒有保護效果。
research.RUNICSHIELDING.title: 盧恩護盾
research.SANESOAP.stage.1:
我似乎在偶然中發現了解決方案。浴鹽可以放鬆身心，並緩解扭曲的症狀，但是我需要更根本的解決方案。用來徹底清除我身上的扭曲。
帶有善意的魔力可以派上用場。香皂可以清洗身體，若是賦予它適當的信念或許能使它同時淨化心靈？
research.SANESOAP.stage.2:
Eureka（我發現啦）！！ 我解出了一道合成配方，我命名為心神皂（專利申請中）。
這塊香皂可以清洗肉體，但是它特別的地方在於心理上的效果。使用這塊香皂會低機率的減少非永久性的扭曲，並清除所有暫時性的扭曲。
若使用時處於扭曲防護的狀態下或是泡在淨化泉中，可以增加消除扭曲的機率。
research.SANESOAP.title: 心神皂
research.SEALBREAK.stage.1: Specially equipped and instructed golems should be capable of digging and breaking blocks. I just need to design the proper seal for that task.
research.SEALBREAK.stage.2:
This seal commands golems to break any blocks they find in the area.
The hardness of a block determines how quickly it can be broken.
It is possible to filter the type of blocks to be broken or ignored.
It should be noted that due to factors like golem mobility, limited area, and speed, this seal probably will not make a very effective mining tool, though it could be used as such in a pinch.
research.SEALBREAK.stage.ADV:
I can now craft an advanced version of the seal that will allow you to filter more items at once and allow the golem to break blocks as if they are using Silk Touch.
Golems will take longer to break block if Silk Touch is used.
research.SEALBREAK.title: 控制印記：方塊破壞者
research.SEALBUTCHER.stage.1:
While §5Guard§0 seals can be used to kill animals, they are not very selective.
I should refine the arcane algorithms in a guard seal to make it more suited for animal farming.
research.SEALBUTCHER.stage.2: The butcher seal works much like a §5Guard§0 seal, except it only targets adult animals. Furthermore it will always make sure that at least one breeding pair of animals remain alive.
research.SEALBUTCHER.title: 控制印記：屠夫
research.SEALCOLLECT.stage.1:
這顆印記會持續檢測指定區域中的掉落物。當發現物品時會指示附近的傀儡將物品撿起。
我可以指定檢測的確切範圍，也能利用黑白名單篩選物品。
research.SEALCOLLECT.stage.ADV:
我現在能製作出高等版的印記，能一次篩選多種物品。它也能更妥善的控制篩選方式，但是需要更聰明的傀儡才能達成這顆印記指派的工作。
我可以選擇讓印記在篩選時忽略 NBT 或損壞值、或是利用礦物辭典、甚至能讓印記篩選來自相同模組的物品。
research.SEALCOLLECT.title: 控制印記：收集
research.SEALEMPTY.stage.1:
我可以指示傀儡撿起並存放物品，但或許我也會需要從容器中尋找物品。
設計這種印記應該不會太困難。
research.SEALEMPTY.stage.2:
這種印記作用與儲存相反。它會清空指定容器中的物品。附近的任何傀儡都會取出容器中的物品並拿在手上。你需要利用其他印記指示傀儡對手中的物品進行其他操作。
你可以篩選特定物品或是將特定物品除外。
research.SEALEMPTY.stage.ADV:
我現在能製作出高等版的印記，能一次篩選多種物品。它也能更妥善的控制篩選方式，但是需要更聰明的傀儡才能達成這顆印記指派的工作。
我可以選擇讓印記在篩選時忽略 NBT 或損壞值、或是利用礦物辭典、甚至能讓印記篩選來自相同模組的物品。
你也可以讓印記依列表順序一次只篩選一項物品。
research.SEALEMPTY.title: 控制印記：淨空
research.SEALGUARD.stage.1:
Though small, thaumaturgical golems should be perfectly capable of combat.
Combat is quite a complex task, however, and I will need to carefully test the seal to avoid accidents.
research.SEALGUARD.stage.2:
When placed, this seal will protect an area from intrusion. Any hostile creatures it detects will be targeted by nearby combat-capable golems and attacked.
If the golem has the §5Deft§0 property, any creatures slain will drop experience orbs as if killed by a player.
§9This research also unlocks additional golem parts§0.
research.SEALGUARD.stage.ADV: I can now create an advanced version of the seal that will give greater control over which creatures my golems will target.
research.SEALGUARD.title: 控制印記：守衛
research.SEALHARVEST.stage.1:
Farming is a menial task best performed by a golem and not a busy thaumaturge like myself.
Designing a seal that will instruct golems to harvest crops will save me a lot of manual labor in the long run.
research.SEALHARVEST.stage.2:
This seal will search the designated area for any fully-grown crops or other harvestable plants. Once found, a golem will be dispatched to harvest the plant.
If required, the seal will also attempt to replant the harvested crop as long as seeds (or similar items) are available. If the seed was previously planted on farmland and the soil has turned into dirt, the golem will also try to till the block.
research.SEALHARVEST.title: 控制印記：收成
research.SEALLUMBER.stage.1: While the §5Block Breaker§0 seal can be used to chop down trees it is not particularly effective at the task. I should do something about that.
research.SEALLUMBER.stage.2:
A refinement of the §5Block Breaker§0 seal, the Lumberjack seal will only target wooden logs, but instead of breaking the log the golem is hitting, it will instead break the furthest connected log.
This means that it is highly effective when used to harvest trees, as it will effectively chop them from the top down.
research.SEALLUMBER.title: 控制印記：伐木工
research.SEALPROVIDE.stage.1: I should design a refinement of the Empty seal that will only remove items that are specifically requested by other seals.
research.SEALPROVIDE.stage.2:
This seal is similar to the Empty seal, except it will only remove an item from the inventory if there is a specific need for it.
Certain seals may request provisioning. If they require specific items for their tasks a secondary task will be created telling a nearby golem to retrieve those items from any inventories marked with a Provide seal.
This task will use the requesting seals priority and the golem needs to meet the requirements for both the Provider seal and the requesting seal.
The filter on the Provide seal is merely used to compare what items may be taken from the container. The filters (if any) on the requesting seal will determine the exact item taken.
research.SEALPROVIDE.title: 控制印記：供給
research.SEALSTOCK.stage.1: I need a seal that will allow me to keep a minimum number of items stocked in a container at all times.
research.SEALSTOCK.stage.2:
This seal is similar to the store seal, except it keeps a certain number of items stocked inside its container at all times. The seal only insures that a minimum number of items are kept in stock - it will not prevent overstocking should it occur by other means.
This seal requires provider seals to know where to get the items.
research.SEALSTOCK.title: Control Seal: Stock
research.SEALSTORE.stage.1:
這顆印記可以貼在容器側面。它可以將容器指定為傀儡的物品接收處。只要容器允許，傀儡就會把手上的物品裝進去。
你也可以用黑/白名單篩選各種物品。
你也能利用白名單指定容器中特定物品的數量，預設為無限（以金色星號表示）。
如果印記不是貼在容器上，傀儡會直接把物品丟向該處。
你也可以指定該處的物品數量，與用於容器時無異。印記半徑一格內的物品都會納入計算。
research.SEALSTORE.stage.ADV:
我現在能製作出高等版的印記，能一次篩選多種物品。它也能更妥善的控制篩選方式，但是需要更聰明的傀儡才能達成這顆印記指派的工作。
我可以選擇讓印記在篩選時忽略 NBT 或損壞值、或是利用礦物辭典、甚至能讓印記篩選來自相同模組的物品。
若白名單有指定物品數量，所有符合篩選條件的物品都會被計入。
research.SEALSTORE.title: 控制印記：儲存
research.SEALUSE.stage.1: I should be able to design a seal that allows golems to interact with the world in more complex ways than simply carrying items around or attacking things. There are many objects that require manual operation and maybe I can have golems do that for me.
research.SEALUSE.stage.2:
This seal allows a golem to act like a player and left- or right-click on a marked block.
The golem can also click with any items it happens to be holding, or specific filtered items.
The seal will remain even if the block it was placed on is removed, allowing the seal to target empty air if desired.
If a whitelist item is specified, the golem can also request to be §5Provisioned§0.
research.SEALUSE.title: 控制印記：使用
research.THAUMATORIUM.stage.1:
煉金過程總會遇到一些挫折與失誤——算錯要素、源質降解，而且材料需要勞心費神手動混合。 我受夠了。
現在我有了純粹的液態源質，我應該改善整個煉金過程。
research.THAUMATORIUM.stage.2:
我發明了一項自動裝置，並命名為秘術煉成機。就像其他複合式裝置一樣需要利用世界鹽來製作。
秘術煉成機是能讓秘術師選擇煉成公式與觸媒的一項神奇發明。可以透過管道中自動抽取所需的源質。只需提供觸媒，它就能完美地持續合成每項物品。
底座的的坩堝並不需要添水，但其下方依舊需要提供熱源。開啟該設備後會看見一些格子。左上方的格子用來放置觸媒。 放置好後便能在右上方的可成列表中選擇欲合成的配方。
右邊會列出所需的源質，裝置運作時還會顯示出進度條。
製成的物品會從設備前方彈出或者投入放置於彈射口位置的容器中。一般來說一個秘術煉成機只能同時使用一組配方，但在其周圍安附記憶方體就能增加它同時掌握的配方數量。
每個記憶方體能夠增添2組配方。
research.THAUMATORIUM.title: 煉金自動化
research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.1:
作為一位秘術師，光是觀察這個世界或是研讀古籍是無法進步的。我需要透過實驗中的發現來拓展自己的知識。而唯一的方法就是建立我自己的理論。
我需要一個有充足文具（例如紙筆與墨水）的舒適工作環境。看來我需要製作一些文具並擺在桌上。
research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.2:
現在我有了自己的工作空間，該著手進行研究了。我可以建立自己的魔法操作理論來達成我的需求。
首先，我必須確保桌上有大量紙張，而且書記工具中有充足的墨水。現在我可以選擇開始研究理論。 arcaneresearch:textures/research/research1.png:0:0:128:96:1在頁面的頂部顯示的是我現在有多少靈感（以燈泡來表示）可供我進行這次研究。進行研究時左邊會出現一疊紙張。當我點選紙張時，會給予兩條研究路線可供選擇。每個研究路線會敘述我能獲得的知識，可能是一種或多研究類別。
有些選擇會有需求物品。標有金黃色§6！§r的物品會在選取卡片後消耗掉。
通常我只能探究我已解鎖的研究類別，但我相信偶爾也能發現全新的研究路線。
我可以持續抽出我的下一步研究。但我無論如何都該留意的是每次選擇都會消耗我的靈感。靈感一但耗盡研究就會完成。隨著魔法知識的累積，開始研究時獲得的靈感也會增多。
我研究項目的進度是以百分比來表示——當達成100%就代表完成了一個完整的理論。即使未達到100%，在完成研究後也會納入你的研究對應的知識類別。你可以在同一個類別中獲得超過100%。 然而只有最高的類別能獲得完整加成，其他類別都會損失總分的33%。
§n研究輔助§r
通常研究都有些漫無目的。我可以利用研究輔助來主導自己的研究。如果我在研究過程中使用某些附近的方塊、物品或是文物，就能將我的研究集中在特定的方面。 arcaneresearch:textures/research/research1.png:128:0:128:96:1舉例而言，周圍的書架可以在我進行研究時做為參考資料來源。這些屬於有特殊限制的研究路線比一般的項目抽中機率更高。這些研究會帶有燙金的邊框，以和平常抽出的研究作區隔。舉例來說，書架可以給予額外的通用理論選擇，而只有當周圍有書架時才有兩次抽出註解的機會。
你可以在開始建立研究時選擇你要使用的研究輔助，但必須留意，使用每項輔助都會減少一點靈感。
可能還有很多很多東西可以做為研究輔助。我應該要多加嘗試。
research.THEORYRESEARCH.title: 建立理論
research.TUBES.stage.1:
儘管我可以透過瓶罐運送源質，但是這對大規模的煉金操作而言不怎麼有效率。 顯然利用管道運輸源質會是正解，但其活性導致無法使用一般的管路運輸。
我應該蒐集一些不同的源質樣本來測試各種材料。
research.TUBES.stage.2:
我解開了穩定且更加封閉的管路製造關鍵。 雖然一般的化學物質能用玻璃來運輸，然而某些源質卻能將之溶解，甚至可能直接穿透過去。 我以鐵包覆玻璃，並施加水銀處理，以確保即使遇上最不穩定的源質也不易受損。以黃銅零件完善管道系統，並使它耀眼奪目。管道主要是為蒸餾器與封罐所設計，但也能用在任何煉金設備上。
當有像封罐這種可用的容器被接上時，源質就會透過管道流向容器。
裝有不同類型源質的罐子只會將同類型的源質吸向自己。 然而管道一次只能抽取並運輸一種源質，所以吸引力最高的源質會優先。 如果不妥善的使用閥門，管道網很容易就會被塞住。閥門是一項必用零件。
如果你看到氣體從管子裡噴出，意味著有不同種類的吸力相互干擾。你可以從氣體的顏色推測發生問題的吸力類型。透過施術器輕觸管道的側面可以接上或斷開鄰近管道的連結。
施術器也能輕觸像閥門這種管道的中央來旋轉管道方向。arcaneresearch:textures/items/resonator.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質共鳴器能協助管道網除錯。 可以透過它來觀測管道和其他源質裝置所容納的源質以及目前正在作用中的吸引力。arcaneresearch:textures/items/tube_valve.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質閥門運作機制跟普通管道相同，但是能手動或用紅石信號將它關閉。拴上後會截斷源質的流動。arcaneresearch:textures/items/tube_filter.png:0:0:255:255:.125過濾源質管道功能類似普通管道，不過可以用標籤、管型瓶之類的物品來標記單一類型的源質。經過標記的管道只允許其標定的源質流通。
潛行並空手輕觸管道可以解除過濾器。arcaneresearch:textures/items/tube_restrict.png:0:0:255:255:.125限制源質管道功能類似普通管道，但是能將任何吸力減半。arcaneresearch:textures/items/tube_oneway.png:0:0:255:255:.125定向源質管道只接受單向的吸力。 藍色的標記指出其接受的吸力方向。arcaneresearch:textures/items/tube_buffer.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質緩衝器能同時容納任何類型的源質，但是容量有限——最多只能存放8點。 它跟罐子一樣具有吸力，但是其吸引力只達最低限度(1)。
這意味著它通常得緊貼著來源才能主動抽取源質。管道能接在緩衝器的任何一面，能同時從裝置中提取出任何源質的這項特性無可取代。
你可以在緩衝器上加裝風箱——每座風箱可增加32吸力。
此外你也能單獨接上或斷開每面的管道，潛行時操作連接面則可以將吸力設定在1（藍環）或0（紅環）。
這些特性使源質管道系統多了一些有趣的可能性。
research.TUBES.title: 源質管道
research.TaintCrawler.stage.1:
這些噁心的蛆蟲不管爬到哪都不停地散佈腐蝕液。一般而言這些腐蝕現象在離源頭太遠的地方很快就會消退，然而也有機會導致腐蝕漫延得更快。
最好在發現的當下立即撲殺。
research.TaintSeed.stage.1:
有時腐蝕植株的捲鬚會纏繞成團狀。瘴氣會從這顆作為腐蝕發展源的「種子」中噴湧而出。
這些種子會擺動來自我防衛，但若想要擺脫區域的腐蝕就必須冒險清除它。
少了種子產生的瘴氣，腐蝕植株很快就揮枯萎死亡。
research.TaintSwarm.stage.1:
有時受腐蝕的樹木會長出紫色的蜂巢狀組織。微小的螫人生物群會從中生成並蜂湧而出。
它們移動敏捷，難以閃避或擊落。幸運的是其個體還算脆弱，有做好準備的旅人應該能夠輕鬆處理。
research.Taintacle.stage.1:
這些像觸手一樣的危險組織體會鞭向任何靠近它的物體。
雖然它們固定不動，但保持距離也無法保證你的安全，因為當它們注意到你時還會在你周圍伸出其他小觸手。
research.ThaumSlime.stage.1:
這些紫色史萊姆是其綠色遠親的一個奇特分歧種。普通的史萊姆是從滲入洞穴中的有機淤泥中生成，而玄秘史萊姆是由魔法失敗所殘留下的紫色原始物質凝聚而成。
與它們綠色的遠親相較之下除了那異常的起源外幾乎大同小異。它們擁有主動分離自己身體的能力，會對接近它的目標噴吐小型的史萊姆。而當周圍沒有攻擊目標時，分離的史萊姆將互相吸引，重新結合成一團更大的個體。
research.UNLOCKALCHEMY.stage.1:
釀造藥水簡單而有效，然而單純把怪物的器官搗在一起可不能稱為真正的煉成反應。
我認為源質在一個更加複雜的物質操作手法中扮演相當重要的關鍵。
我應該嘗試深入研究煉金術，了解它在這魔法世界中扮演的角色。
有了這些知識以及一些靈感，我相信我能妥善掌握秘術煉金。
research.UNLOCKALCHEMY.stage.2:
我最近的研究使我對世界的組成有了進一步的理解，我覺得似乎找到了能透過操作源質來改變物質的方法。
這方法需要能夠容納煉金基質的物品來進行實驗。簡單的釀造台無法達成目的——我需要的是一個神祕的坩堝。
鍋釜的尺寸與形狀符合需求，然而這樣的一個大鐵碗可沒辦法容納我想操作的魔法能量。
同樣的，對這鍋釜撒上世界鹽應該能解決我的問題。
research.UNLOCKALCHEMY.stage.3:
我的坩堝完成了！是時候來加以實驗了，而碰巧有項物品完美勝任第一個煉金實驗。我經常徹夜研讀秘術，而閃爍的火炬並不是良好的閱讀光源。我現在需要的正是個穩定的魔法光源。
螢石是一種穩定的光源，但是我需要充沛的光源，而且它缺乏...格調。我很確定我可以把它變得更好。
坩堝需要放置在熱源上並裝滿水。當水沸騰後我就可以開始添加我需要的東西。我寫出了一份配方，我認為應該能夠創造出我稱為明耀之源的物質。以能量、火、以及光來驅動小小的螢光核心，應該能使它永不熄滅。其重量應該輕盈地能讓我擺在任何位置——甚至是飄在半空中。
我只需要找到帶有所需源質的那些物件（按住 shift 並將游標指向物品應該能有所幫助）並將它們投入坩堝。
坩堝會將這些物件分解成構成它們的源質。我可能無法湊到剛好的源質組合，但只要總量足夠一切應該不會有問題。
當一切就緒的最後我只需要投入觸媒。在這個例子下是指螢石粉。
如果一切順利螢石會吸收源質而轉變成明耀之源。
我不確定多餘的源質會造成什麼現象，但我也只能假設它們最後會無害地消散。
［空手按住 shift +右鍵 可以清空坩堝。由於每次操作都會消耗一些水，所以你必須一再地重新為它添水。］
research.UNLOCKALCHEMY.title: 探索煉金術
research.UNLOCKARTIFICE.stage.1:
長我已經學到了不少事物，而其中一點是明白了我所看見的還遠遠不夠。這世界向我展現其神秘與奧妙，以及許多奇蹟...以及危險。
我需要一項可以使我看見隱藏之物的工具，以幫助我在旅途中發現新知。我研讀的古老文獻提到了過去的秘術師通常會用一組護目鏡來達成這項目的。
可惜文獻中並未記載其作用原理，所以我得自己從頭開始設計。
research.UNLOCKARTIFICE.stage.2:
我從找到的些許資訊與自己的實驗結果中畫出了自己的設計。該是動手實作的時候了。
這副護目鏡不只能揭示隱藏的事物，還能減低某些秘術操作的魔素消耗。
最後，這組護目鏡還能讓我看見物體中所容納的魔素或源質，我相信這會是最大的優勢。 最重大的發現是我可以利用魔法並灌注奧術能量來製造出精密的機械。
research.UNLOCKARTIFICE.title: 探索匠法
research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.1:
製作使用魔素力量的物品使我開了眼界，然而我並未滿足於此。一定有方法能直接操作靈氣。汲取大氣中的魔素並依我的意志來驅使的方法。
我應該走遍世界的邊境。肯定能在哪裡習得我所需的知識。
有時我會覺得我受到我理解範圍外的力量驅使——無人能聞的聲音催促我邁向宏大的力量與知識。
將魔素定型將是旅途的下一步。
research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.2:
緩慢而確實的，我逐漸理解了魔素的本質。對我而言魔素還有很多未解之謎，但我認為我已經得到足以讓魔素如願成形的知識。為此我需要一項工具，非常特殊的工具。
我發現了由一位長眠的秘術師留下來的一些塵封卷軸。上面敘述著如何製作用以儲存與驅動魔素的魔杖。我在卷軸中所學到的知識相當實用，然而使用上似乎受到相當程度的限制。何必將四周充沛的魔素限制在法杖之中？對我而言連魔杖本身都太過不切實際。如果需要一個可以抓住靈氣並使它成形的工具，像手套那樣的形狀應該相當適合。
沒有任何破舊手套能勝任——這需要用上最好的皮革，並以魔素的良導體做為繫帶，從頭開始純手工製成。鐵並非優良的魔素導體，但這對現在的我而言已算堪用。
幸運的是我不需要去找什麼神奇木頭來儲存魔素，但我需要用其他方式來引導靈氣——魔素共鳴器能滿足這項需求。我也會將一片簡化的秘術觀測鏡裝在手套上，以便於隨時監控周圍的靈氣。
最後，我會在手套背面加設計一個槽位。卷軸上有提到需要用特殊的晶體法術核心來引導法杖的魔素。其不同的晶格結構能創造各種實用性的效果。 確實，我一開始還真沒想到這個做法。幸運的是我已經想到幾種方法來改善手套的設計與形狀，使魔素的流動與操作性遠勝於舊式的魔杖。
research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.3:
我成功地組裝出一個基礎的魔導籠手，而我對這成果相當自豪。雖然略顯粗糙，不過作為一組原型這是可以預期的。它將證實即使是原型依舊能派上用場，能使我精確地調整或改造秘術裝置，並安全的進行各種操作。
我的初步實驗顯示它只能汲取我周圍小範圍的魔素。我應該小心避免耗盡區域中的靈氣。
我當下最大的障礙是目前為止它還是只能作為一個魔法板手。在我解出法術核心的製作秘訣之前其功能有限。而我面前的道路如此的明朗...
research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.title: 探索靈氣術
research.UNLOCKELDRITCH.stage.1: 緋紅教徒們滿腦子詭異的思想，但似乎包含了潛藏的真相。或許我該找個方法來證實他們所暗示的事物？誰會知道我能從中找到怎麼樣的知識...
research.UNLOCKELDRITCH.stage.2:
我發現了一些詭異的東西...無法吻合於現實世界的的規則和我們所知的常識。
我完全不相信這些種子是來自於我們的現實世界。這肯定是來自於...外界。
我必須進一步加以研究...必須更進一步。
research.UNLOCKELDRITCH.title: 探究異象
research.UNLOCKGOLEMANCY.stage.1:
這本書教導我許多事物：如何造基本層面上操作物質與魔法，如何對物體賦予魔法，甚至是如何從空氣中汲取魔力。但依舊避開了某些東西。
每個人都能做到某些很基本，但卻非常神奇的魔法。只要將幾個方塊以特定的結構堆好，就能將它們化為類似生命體的自動傀儡。這怎麼可能？哪有這種事情？靈氣是不是太過於自作主張了？
我應該要好好研究這個現象。
research.UNLOCKGOLEMANCY.stage.2:
我的發現有些難以說明。
「天然」的傀儡確實被注入了魔素，然而我並不相信這些創造物來自天然的秘術。驅動它們的力量顯然來自於其他地方。
至少我的研究還算有些成果。我相信我可以從研究中以秘術原理重現這種驅動力。我應該要趕緊進行下一步研究。
research.UNLOCKGOLEMANCY.title: 探索傀儡學
research.UNLOCKINFUSION.stage.1:
以往將魔素附在物件上一直被視為理所當然。這種簡單的附魔只要用隨處可見的附魔台就能達成。但我相信不只如此——透過利用源質對物件進行§o注魔§r，應該能讓我以人工的方式強制使它容納其他物件的性質、要素甚至是抽象的概念。
任何人都能對物件施以魔法使之升空，但注魔應該能對能物體灌注輕盈本身，使它成為一種自然性質。
research.UNLOCKINFUSION.stage.2:
我的實驗相當成功。 我已經能將源質注入簡單的物件中，但過程相當複雜、困難且危險。我需要找到簡化的方法才能真正開始鑽研它所擁有的一切可能性。 這些實驗也帶來了一些實際的成果。
我發現了一種柔軟滑順，而且易於附魔的布料。我設計了一套由這種布料製成的衣服。
這套衣服不但舒適有型，穿著時還能減低各種秘術操作的魔素消耗。這套衣服也像皮甲一樣易於染色。
總而言之我對目前為止的一切都相當滿意。
research.UNLOCKINFUSION.title: 探索注魔
research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.1: 我偶爾會發現自己受到毒或是其他煩人的異常狀態影響。我應該要設法保護自己。
research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.2:
我設計了一種神祕護符，會釋出治癒脈動來清除我身上的毒或是其他異常狀態。只可惜這不能治療物理上的傷口。
戒指帶有魔素容量，需透過充魔基座或類似裝置進行充魔——它無法直接汲取靈氣中的魔素。 我有兩種能用於增強護符效果的特殊附魔。 §n生命供給§r
這項注魔附魔使蔥蘢之心護符能回復穿戴者的生命值。 §n體力維持§r
這項注魔附魔使蔥蘢之心護符能緩慢餵飽其穿戴者，並提供空氣以呼吸。
research.VERDANTCHARMS.title: 蔥蘢護符
research.VISAMULET.stage.1: 目前如果我想替我的魔素道具充魔，我必須回到最近的充魔基座，或是把基座帶著走。再怎麼說這樣都稱不上方便——我必須找出一個能隨身為物品充魔的方法。
research.VISAMULET.stage.2:
我製作了一個能從靈氣中引導魔素的護身符，讓我能在物品的魔素消耗時自動從附近區域補充。
護符只能為快捷欄、配件或是護甲欄位（依照此順序）的物品充魔。它只會替能夠用充魔基座充魔的物品充魔。
research.VISAMULET.title: 魔素護符
research.VISBATTERY.stage.1:
自然界的魔素水晶就像飾魔素的「電池」。當環境中靈氣充裕時它會吸收靈氣，並在靈氣缺乏時釋出。然而這過程既緩慢又不可靠。
利用研究魔素水晶成長過程時學到的知識，我應該能自己製造出更加可靠的魔素儲存槽。
research.VISBATTERY.stage.2:
我成功地製造出了魔素槽。
若當地的魔素高於平常容量的95%，魔素槽會吸收魔素，並在靈氣降至75%以下時釋出。
這多少有些缺點。即使它遠比自然界的水晶更可靠，魔素槽依舊需要一些時間來反應靈氣的變化。另一個缺點在於容量。它只能儲存10點魔素。我試圖改善但結果相當慘烈。我想這只意味著投入實用所需要的數量更多。
紅石訊號不只能停止魔素槽作用，還會快速的將魔素槽中所有的魔素釋放回靈氣中。
research.VISBATTERY.title: 魔素槽
research.VISGENERATOR.stage.1:
魔素無法像紅石、RedstoneFlux 或 ForgeEnergy 一樣作為凡世的能量來源，這是眾所皆知的事實。
問題是：你能不能用魔素發電？顯然答案是不行的，但我若止步於這個顯然的結論，我將不配自稱秘術師。
research.VISGENERATOR.stage.2:
午餐時間都還沒到我又把一個不可能從我的筆記中劃掉了。
我設法利用魔素來產生凡俗的能源，但是需要運用一些小伎倆。將動能轉換成能量相當簡單，而利用魔素產生動能可說是秘術師的入門課題。利用魔素來轉動發電機是不可行的，因為魔法能量會隨著轉軸滲入發電機導致各種問題。
最後我利用磁力與一些精巧的工法設計出一種特殊的連接方式。這種連接方式能在魔素與凡世能源不互相干涉的前提下傳遞動能。
遺憾的是這種連接方式造成的動能損失限制了所能產生的能源。它能直接汲取靈氣中的魔素，每一點魔素能產生 1000 FE/RF， 但是每刻僅能輸出 20 FE/RF。
可以用紅石訊號暫停發電機。
research.VISGENERATOR.title: 魔素動力發電機
research.VOIDROBEARMOR.stage.1: The simple void metal armor I can now craft is practical, but not particularly useful to full blooded thaumaturge like myself. I should craft something better. Much better.
research.VOIDROBEARMOR.stage.2:
Using the knowledge I have gained thus far, I have designed a set of armored robes that combines the utility of Thaumaturge's Robes with the practacality of Thaumium Fortress Armor.
Primarily made from void metal this armor has all the benefits (and side-effects) that metal offers.
Lastly, the hood of the robes contain integrated Goggles of Revealing.
This armor can be dyed.
research.VOIDROBEARMOR.title: Void Thaumaturge Armor
research.VOIDSEERPEARL.stage.1:
In madness there is insight. Or so I have been told... I'm not sure by who, but it has the ring of truth about it.
I have been having strange thoughts and ideas of late, but their significance and meaning is just outside my grasp. If I can focus my mind somehow I might be able to see... more.
research.VOIDSEERPEARL.stage.2:
When I hold this charm I get glimpses of what lies beyond. The meaning still eludes me, but I feel more connected to the aura and magic than I have ever felt before.
While I have this charm equipped I will find vis much easier to manipulate.
Oddly enough, the size of the bonus seems to be proportional to the amount of permanent warp I have suffered. What a strange coincidence.
research.VOIDSEERPEARL.title: Voidseer's Pearl
research.VOIDSIPHON.stage.1:
Destroying a rift to get Void Seeds is highly impractical. I must find a better way.
While most Crimson Cultist rantings are nonsense, they do make reference to drawing power from rifts. I believe it should be possible to siphon off some of the eldritch energy in rifts to form Void Seeds without destroying the rift outright.
research.VOIDSIPHON.stage.2:
I hate to admit it, but the Crimson Cultists might be on to something. I have managed to design a Void Siphon that slowly leeches energy from nearby rifts. This leeched energy will slowly form Void Seeds. The larger the rift is, the quicker this process occurs.
Unfortunately this is not without consequence for the rift itself. The rift will become increasingly unstable and will slowly shrink as it's energy is leeched away. I must take care to not overuse them.
A redstone signal will disable the Void Siphon.
research.VOIDSIPHON.title: Void Siphon
research.WARDEDJARS.stage.1:
源質可以儲存在§l封罐§r之中。
封罐可以擺在各種地方，而且幾乎可以無限期地保存源質。附在罐子上的魔法也使得裝填和提取源質輕而易舉。
直接拿封罐輕觸蒸餾器就能將蒸餾器中的源質裝進封罐。也能利用管型瓶來裝填或提取源質。
更棒的是把這拿來裝果醬或蜜餞堪稱完美。
潛行並空手輕觸罐子或蒸餾器就能把它們清空。 只要罐子中裝有源質，你就能為它貼上§l封罐標籤§r。
這個標籤將會「鎖定」這個罐子所能盛裝的源質類型，使它無法接收任何其他類型的源質。
潛行並輕觸貼有標籤的那一面就能將罐子上的標籤撕下。注意若潛行輕觸其他面的話罐子會被清空。
你可以在工作台上用管型瓶為標籤指定要素，貼在空罐上就能自動鎖定其要素。管型瓶中的源質不會被消耗。
將它貼在裝有源質的罐子上標籤會被罐子中的源質類型覆蓋。
標籤放進合成欄可以重新合成為空白標籤。 你也可以製作§l黃銅蓋箍§r。套在罐子上可以防止除了管子以外的任何外力抽取或填充罐子。
取下罐子時蓋箍會作為單獨物件掉落。
research.WARDEDJARS.title: 封罐與標籤
research.WARP.stage.1:
許多人認為不應該涉足魔法，沒什麼能比扭曲更能證實這項觀點。
從事禁忌的魔法研究或者製作悖於自然的造物，都會讓秘術師眼中的現實世界無論在精神上還是在肉體上都出現畸變，此現象謂之扭曲。
雖然有些扭曲是暫時的，會隨著時間而消退，然而目前尚未找到任何能消除永久性扭曲的手段。當一個秘術師選擇忽視扭曲的危險並持續追求力量，往往會發現自己已陷入難以回頭的滑坡。
扭曲通常徵狀為心神恍惚，肉體疼痛或者出現幻覺。
這些徵狀並不僅僅只是精神上的疾患，有時候視野中會湧現出實用知識，而幻覺也會駭人地化為實體。
我應該好好的監測自己的心理健康狀況，我為此設計了一項設備，應該能準確告訴我何時該停下腳步。
research.WARP.title: 扭曲
research.WARP.warn: 我的思緒受我所學干涉
research.WORKBENCHCHARGER.stage.1:
我在奧術工作台上遇到一個麻煩的限制。它只能從其周圍汲取魔素。雖然目前為止的合成都能夠完成，但我很快就發現我即將需要用到更多魔素來進行合成。
我必須找出方法來延伸奧術工作台的範圍。若它能汲取到更遠的魔素，能用於合成的魔素也會更充裕。
research.WORKBENCHCHARGER.stage.2:
我設計了一組能安置在奧術工作台與核心操作台上的特殊支架。這組支架讓這些工作台不只能從當下區塊汲取魔素，周圍八個區塊也會納入其汲取的範圍。理論上這讓可用於合成的魔素達到九倍之多。
合成所需的魔素會從九個區塊中分別汲取，如此一來應該能避免耗盡單一區塊中的魔素。
research.WORKBENCHCHARGER.title: 工作台充魔架
research.Wisp.stage.1:
這些神奇的生物看起來就像漂浮的光點，時常出現在魔素濃厚的地方。老實說我完全不確定它們究竟是不是生物——它們漫無目的地飄移，而且絲毫沒有展現出任何像是正常生命體的特徵。它們受到攻擊會進行反擊，有時則會毫無徵兆的變得兇暴。
我剛開始時認為他們可能是某種形式的原始生物，並非由物質，而是由魔素構成，然而當我在它們中心觀測到異樣的次元能量後我就發現事情沒有我想的那麼單純。

It is time you changed this and you think you might have found an arcane machine that can do this.
tempnote.ARCANEDOOR.name: Warded Stone and Doors
tempnote.ARCANEDOOR.text: Some random experimentation has led to an interesting discovery - the ability to imprint memories in inanimate objects. Your first attempt at using the discovery is blocks and doors that remember who placed them.
tempnote.ARCANEEAR.name: Arcane Ear
tempnote.ARCANEEAR.text: Sound is another aspect of the natural world that could use some study. Maybe it can be harnessed with magic to create a magical sensor of some kind?
tempnote.ARCANEPLATE.name: Arcane Pressure Plate
tempnote.ARCANEPLATE.text: Warded stone, glass and doors have been a great success and you think you should see what else can be taught to recognize you. What about a versatile pressure plate that just responds to you or anyone except you?
tempnote.ASPECT.name: Aspects of Magic
tempnote.AURA.name: The Aura
tempnote.BALC.name: Basic Alchemy
tempnote.BART.name: Basic Artificing
tempnote.BASICFLUX.name: Basic Flux Research
tempnote.BASICFLUX.popup: There must be ways to control it
tempnote.BASICFLUX.text: You have started searching for some device or means to control and limit Flux. Examining silverwood might give you more clues since it has a natural resistance to Flux.
tempnote.BASTRANS.name: Basic Transmutation
tempnote.BASTRANS.popup: Transformation of base metals into gold
tempnote.BASTRANS.text: By studying the rudiments of alchemy and the properties of metals, you think you might have stumbled upon a way to transform base metals into gold.
tempnote.BOOTSTRAVELLER.name: Boots of the Traveller
tempnote.BOOTSTRAVELLER.popup: These boots were made for walking
tempnote.BOOTSTRAVELLER.text: A good pair of boots is a boon to any traveller. A magical pair of boots is even better, allowing you to run faster, jump higher and swim faster.
tempnote.CINDERPEARL.name: Cinderpearl
tempnote.CRUCIBLE.name: Crucible
tempnote.CRYSTALCAPACITOR.name: Crystal Capacitor
tempnote.CRYSTALCAPACITOR.popup: Storing vis for a rainy day.
tempnote.CRYSTALCAPACITOR.text: You have recently started experiencing problems with you vis supply. You suspect you might have depleted or mined too much of the local infused ore. You need an artificial way of storing vis for later use.
tempnote.CRYSTALCLUSTER.name: Crystal Clusters
tempnote.CRYSTALCLUSTER.text: There have been longstanding rumours that the crystalline shards found in infused ore can be fused together into larger crystals.
tempnote.CRYSTALCORE.name: Basic Aura Manipulation
tempnote.CRYSTALCORE.popup: Magic at your beck and call
tempnote.CRYSTALCORE.text: Aura nodes are difficult to find and not always conveniently located. You know they are able to move under the proper circumstances and you are sure you can duplicate that effect. It will require great control and a fair deal of mystical energy, but you are sure it can be done.
tempnote.ELEMENTALAXE.name: Axe of the Stream
tempnote.ELEMENTALAXE.text: It is time to test exactly how much magic thaumium can absorb. You have discovered a way of infusing a thaumium axe with the element of water.
tempnote.ELEMENTALHOE.name: Hoe of Growth
tempnote.ELEMENTALHOE.text: It is time to test exactly how much magic thaumium can absorb. You have discovered a way of infusing a thaumium hoe with nurturing and natural magic.
tempnote.ELEMENTALPICKAXE.name: Pickaxe of the Core
tempnote.ELEMENTALPICKAXE.text: It is time to test exactly how much magic thaumium can absorb. You have discovered a way of infusing a thaumium pickaxe with the element of fire.
tempnote.ELEMENTALSHOVEL.name: Shovel of the Earthmover
tempnote.ELEMENTALSHOVEL.text: It is time to test exactly how much magic thaumium can absorb. You have discovered a way of infusing a thaumium shovel with the element of earth.
tempnote.ELEMENTALSWORD.name: Sword of the Zephyr
tempnote.ELEMENTALSWORD.text: It is time to test exactly how much magic thaumium can absorb. You have discovered a way of infusing a thaumium sword with the element of air.
tempnote.ENCHANTS.name: Enchantments
tempnote.ENCHFABRIC.name: Enchanted Fabric
tempnote.ENCHFABRIC.text: You have created a simple, but strong fabric from wool and spider silk. You are sure you can infuse it with magic somehow to create a wonderful crafting component.
tempnote.FLUX.name: Flux
tempnote.GOGGLES.name: Goggles of Revealing
tempnote.GOGGLES.text: Building on the basic principles of the Thaumometer, you have begun refining its ability to detect magic into something more... revealing. You hope this set of mystical lenses will show you the presence of both magic and Flux.
tempnote.GOLEMANCY.name: Golemancy
tempnote.GOLEMANCY.text: Your studies into animation, motion and living creatures is beginning to bear fruit. You are sure if you can harness this power you should be able to create and control your own magical servants.
tempnote.GOLEMANCYADV.name: Advanced Golemancy
tempnote.GOLEMANCYADV.popup: Taking things to the next step
tempnote.GOLEMANCYADV.text: You now consider yourself well-versed in the art of Golemancy. It is time to expand their capabilities beyond that of simple workers: There is potential to turn them into warriors as well.
tempnote.GOLEMCLAY.name: Clay Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMCLAY.text: Further studies into the properties of earth and stone has led you to a possible refinement of the stone golem. You believe a golem crafted from clay might be able to keep a chest stocked with items you instruct it to.
tempnote.GOLEMCLAYADV.name: Advanced Clay Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMCLAYADV.text: You think that by combining a normal clay golem with a brain in a jar, you might be able to create an intelligent and versatile golem. You only need a way to temper any evil that may result from the jarred brain.
tempnote.GOLEMFAST.name: Golem Animation Core: Speed
tempnote.GOLEMFAST.text: You believe you will be able to modify the basic golem core enabling you to create and control golems that are much faster than the norm.
tempnote.GOLEMSIGHT.name: Golem Animation Core: Perception
tempnote.GOLEMSIGHT.text: You believe you will be able to modify the basic golem core enabling you to create and control golems that are much more perceptive than the norm.
tempnote.GOLEMSMART.name: Golem Animation Core: Intelligence
tempnote.GOLEMSMART.text: You believe you will be able to modify the basic golem core enabling you to create and control golems that are much smarter than the norm.
tempnote.GOLEMSTONE.name: Stone Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMSTONE.text: While studying the properties of stone, you think you may have found a way to apply the principles you have learned to golems. The result may be a golem capable of carrying loads to and from containers.
tempnote.GOLEMSTONEADV.name: Advanced Stone Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMSTONEADV.text: You think that by combining a normal stone golem with a brain in a jar, you might be able to create an intelligent and versatile golem. You only need a way to temper any evil that may result from the jarred brain.
tempnote.GOLEMSTRAW.name: Straw Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMSTRAW.text: You believe you have found a way to increase the perceptive abilities of golems and make them more aware of their surroundings. A good test of your theory would be a golem that can harvest crops and plants.
tempnote.GOLEMSTRONG.name: Golem Animation Core: Strength
tempnote.GOLEMSTRONG.text: You believe you will be able to modify the basic golem core enabling you to create and control golems that are much stronger than the norm.
tempnote.GOLEMTALLOW.name: Tallow Golem Worker
tempnote.GOLEMTALLOW.text: Having mastered the art of making golems fetch and carry for you, the next step would be to make the help you with other things around the lab.
tempnote.GOLEMTALLOWADV.name: Decanting Golem
tempnote.GOLEMTALLOWADV.text: Tallow golems have proven themselve around the lab, but they can only refill crucibles and transporting essentia is quite costly. There must be a way to make them smarter, less wasteful and more flexible.
tempnote.GREATWOOD.name: Greatwood Trees
tempnote.GUNPOWDER.name: Gunpowder
tempnote.GUNPOWDER.text: Since Alumentum has such explosive properties, maybe you can harness some of what you have learned to create something more mundane, but just as explosive.
tempnote.HANDMIRROR.name: Magical Hand Mirror
tempnote.HANDMIRROR.text: Magical mirrors have proven to be a great success. If only there was some way to make them a bit more portable.
tempnote.HELLROD.name: Rod of the Nine Hells
tempnote.HELLROD.text: Your trips onto the Nether have taught you to fear the tiny terrors known as Hellbats. If you can harnass the evil little monsters you could strike fear into the heart of your enemies.
tempnote.HOVERHARNESS.name: Thaumostatic Harness
tempnote.HOVERHARNESS.text: By now you have created several things that allows you to defy gravity, but they have proven to be very limited. It is time to make an attempt at discoving true flight.
tempnote.HUNGRYCHEST.name: Hungry Chest
tempnote.HUNGRYCHEST.popup: A chest that doesn't wait to be opened
tempnote.HUNGRYCHEST.text: You think you might be able to imbue a chest with some self-awareness and animation. A chest that could fill itself might prove useful.
tempnote.INFERNALFURNACE.name: Infernal Furnace
tempnote.INFERNALFURNACE.text: The elemental creatures that frequent the Nether known as Blazes seem like they would make perfect sources of heat, if only they can be harnessed properly.
tempnote.INFUSEDORE.name: Infused Ore
tempnote.JAR.name: Warded Jars
tempnote.JAR.text: You think you may have discovered a way to reinforce glass with magic. Crafting a container from this glass could theoretically keep all manner of things inside.
tempnote.JARBRAIN.name: Brain in a Jar
tempnote.JARBRAIN.text: You have been gathering rotten zombie brains for a while now, but with the discovery of warded jars you think you may know a way to give them back a spark of life. Or at least unlife.
tempnote.KNOWLEDGE.name: Knowledge Fragments
tempnote.LEVITATOR.name: Arcane Levitator
tempnote.LEVITATOR.text: Flight is one of mans oldest dreams and magic should be able to accomplish that. Or at least something close. You have stumbled upon a way to break the earth's shackles and counteract gravity in a fairly limited area.
tempnote.MAGBLOCK.name: Magical Building Blocks
tempnote.MAGBLOCK.text: You have been studying ways to combine stone, wood and metals to create building materials suitable for the crafting of mystical objects and constructs.
tempnote.MIRROR.name: Mirror Magic
tempnote.MIRROR.text: Temporarily shifting physical objects into the space between dimensions has proven easy enough, but you are sure there is more you can do. Anyone with even a bit of magical knowledge knows that mirrors can act as gateways to other realms. Maybe you should mix it with dimensional magic and see what happens?
tempnote.NITOR.name: Nitor
tempnote.NITOR.text: This glowing flame seems to be fuelled by magic itself. The number of uses for an everburning flame seems endless, but unfortunately it doesn't seem to produce much heat, though it could prove to be a steady source of light and energy.
tempnote.PHIAL.name: Glass Phial
tempnote.PORTABLEHOLE.name: Portable Hole
tempnote.PORTABLEHOLE.text: Your forays into spatial research have led you to some interesting conclusions. You think you may have stumbled upon a way to shift objects in the material world into another dimension temporarily.
tempnote.RESTABLE.name: Research Table
tempnote.ROBES.name: Thaumaturge's Robes
tempnote.ROBES.text: You have discovered a way to create magical cloth, now you need to discover what you can do with it. The obvious choice seems to be clothing.
tempnote.SCRIBE.name: Scribing Tools
tempnote.SHIMMERLEAF.name: Shimmerleaf
tempnote.SILVERWOOD.name: Silverwood Trees
tempnote.TABLE.name: Tables
tempnote.TALLOW.name: Magic Tallow
tempnote.TALLOW.popup: Rendered fat with a touch of magic
tempnote.TALLOW.text: By processing and heating flesh in the crucible, you believe you can create a mystical tallow suited for many arcane uses.
tempnote.THAUMIUM.name: Thaumium
tempnote.THAUMIUM.text: You have found a way to infuse and transform base metals with raw magical energy. You are hopeful that the resultant material will prove stronger and more resilient than its components.
tempnote.THAUMOMETER.name: Thaumometer
tempnote.THAUMOMETER.text: You believe this mystical device will point you in the direction of nearby sources of mystical energy.
tempnote.THAUMONOMICON.name: Thaumonomicon
tempnote.TINYARMOR.name: Golem Iron Plating
tempnote.TINYARMOR.text: Even sturdy combat golems cannot survive extended engagements or particularly tough foes. These texts have shown you a method of creating armored plating that a golem may wear.
tempnote.TINYBOWTIE.name: Tiny Bowties
tempnote.TINYBOWTIE.text: The texts you have studied speak of miniature clothing and accessories that can be used to improve animated servants. One of these is a small bowtie.
tempnote.TINYDART.name: Golem Dart Launcher
tempnote.TINYDART.text: The texts you have studied has revealed a way to add miniature armaments to your combat golems. One of these is a launcher capable of firing small darts at foes as the golem closes to melee range.
tempnote.TINYFEZ.name: Tiny Fezzes
tempnote.TINYFEZ.text: The texts you have studied speak of miniature clothing and accessories that can be used to improve animated servants. One of these is a small fez.
tempnote.TINYGLASSES.name: Tiny Spectacles
tempnote.TINYGLASSES.popup: The better to see you with.
tempnote.TINYGLASSES.text: The texts you have studied speak of miniature clothing and accessories that can be used to improve animated servants. One of these is a small pair of spectacles.
tempnote.TINYHAT.name: Tiny Hats
tempnote.TINYHAT.text: The texts you have studied speak of miniature clothing and accessories that can be used to improve animated servants. One of these is a small hat.
tempnote.TINYVISOR.name: Golem Visor
tempnote.TINYVISOR.text: These texts has shown you how to create an iron visor that grants a small measure of additional armor to a combat golem. It might also have other benefits.
tempnote.TRANSCOPPER.name: Copper Transmutation
tempnote.TRANSCOPPER.text: Having mastered the transformation of base metals into gold, the next step would be to transform any and all metals into copper.
tempnote.TRANSIRON.name: Iron Transmutation
tempnote.TRANSIRON.text: Having mastered the transformation of base metals into gold, the next step would be to transform any and all metals into iron.
tempnote.TRANSLEAD.name: Lead Transmutation
tempnote.TRANSLEAD.text: Having mastered the transformation of base metals into gold, the next step would be to transform any and all metals into lead.
tempnote.TRANSSILVER.name: Silver Transmutation
tempnote.TRANSSILVER.text: Having mastered the transformation of base metals into gold, the next step would be to transform any and all metals into silver.
tempnote.TRANSTIN.name: Tin Transmutation
tempnote.TRANSTIN.text: Having mastered the transformation of base metals into gold, the next step would be to transform any and all metals into tin.
tempnote.TRAVELSTONE.name: Traveller's Paving Stone
tempnote.TRAVELSTONE.text: Traveling long distances have been made much easier with the Boots of the Traveller, but sometimes you don't have them available or you wish to grant your guests a taste of their power. Surely there is a way to add their magic to the floor itself.
tempnote.TTOE.name: The Theory of Everything
tempnote.TTOE.text: Having studied the classic elements, you now think it is time to broaden your study to the physical world. Hopefully by studying the concrete you will gain an insight into the ethereal.
tempnote.UTFT.name: Unified Thaumic Field Theory
tempnote.UTFT.text: You may be on to something here. For the moment it lies just outside your grasp, but you are beginning to see how the magical, elemental and natural worlds all fit together. Knowledge like this could prove invaluable.
tempnote.WAND.name: Wand of the Apprentice
tempnote.WANDEXCAVATE.name: Wand of Excavation
tempnote.WANDEXCAVATE.text: A logical step in your exploration of magic would be to find a way to utilise it as a mining tool. Studying earthmoving and mining tools should show you the way.
tempnote.WANDEXCHANGE.name: Wand of Equal Trade
tempnote.WANDEXCHANGE.text: Studying the aspect of Permutatio has led you to some interesting conclusions. You think you might be able to create a wand that could exchange one object for another.
tempnote.WANDFIRE.name: Wand of Fire
tempnote.WANDFIRE.text: You think you might be able to adapt the enchantment on a normal wand, turning it into a fire-hurling weapon of destruction.
tempnote.WANDFROST.name: Wand of Frost
tempnote.WANDFROST.popup: Revenge is a dish best served cold
tempnote.WANDFROST.text: You think you might be able to adapt the enchantment on a normal wand, turning it into a ice-hurling weapon of destruction.
tempnote.WANDLIGHTNING.name: Wand of Lightning
tempnote.WANDLIGHTNING.text: You think you might be able to adapt the enchantment on a normal wand, turning it into a lightning-hurling weapon of destruction.
warp.text.10: 你的感官急遽地擴張開來。
warp.text.11: 那是什麼聲音？ 有東西在你身後。
warp.text.13: 你被某種東西盯上了。或許你該收手了。
warp.text.15: 你的肚子發出非常詭異的聲響。
warp.text.16: 你依稀可聽見周圍那幽幽的詠唱聲。
warp.text.2: 你被突如其來的反常飢餓感奪去了體力。
warp.text.3: 古怪的耳語向你傾吐著秘密。
warp.text.4: 你的視野變得詭異而模糊。
warp.text.5: 光線忽然亮得使你難以承受，燒灼著你的皮膚。
warp.text.6: 濃霧自四周湧現，有東西在其深處蠢動。
warp.text.7: 它們無處不在！ 快跑！
warp.text.8: 肯定有方法可以抑制這些痛苦？
warp.text.9: 你忽然對破壞感到厭倦。
warp.text.hunger.1: 平凡的食物無法滿足你。
warp.text.hunger.2: 你的飢餓感已開始消退。
